children: CBOT December corn (CZ26) may slide further into a range of $5.21-1/2 to $5.25 per bushel, as it is about to break the support at $5.27-1/4.
The drop from $5.49-3/4 consists of three waves. The unfolding wave c is expected to be as long as wave a, to travel to $5.21-1/2.

Resistance is at $5.30-3/4, a break above may lead to a gain into the $5.33-1/2 to $5.36-1/4 range. On the daily chart, the current drop is presumed to be riding on wave 4, the fourth wave of a five-wave cycle from $4.57-1/4.
Based on this presumption, the fifth wave, the wave 5 would start upon the completion of the wave 4, driving the market toward $5.48-3/4 again.
